group-zj-2020-jan-seven-choices.overview: 本文是一篇说明文，主题为水资源的重要性与全球缺水问题。文章先指出人体需要水、可直接饮用洁净水，再引出我们也间接用水（农业、发电），随后转折说明世界上许多人喝不到洁净水所带来的疾病与失学问题，最后介绍“世界水日”及英国学校通过负重步行募捐帮助他人获得洁净水的活动。五个空分别考查段首主旨/过渡句、指代衔接和逻辑因果衔接。

discourseStructure.summary: 文章按“引入用水—直接与间接用水—缺水带来的健康与教育问题—世界水日与公益行动”四个层次展开，由个人日常用水推及全球缺水困境，再落到呼吁与行动。

units.summary: 引入主题：人体大量需水、口渴可随手取洁净水（直接用水）；并补充我们也间接用水，如农业种植和发电。
转折指出全球许多人没有洁净水：约7.5亿人缺水，饮用脏水致病致死，儿童因长途取水而失学。
介绍“世界水日”及相关宣传活动，并以英国学校学生负重步行募捐为例，帮助更多人获得洁净水。

topicClues: drink lots of water
fill a glass with clean water
For example, farmers
use water to make the plants grow
produce this energy

contextEvidence.afterQuote: For example, farmers, who produce the food we eat, use water to make the plants grow.

mechanismSignals.targetText: farmers ... use water / produce this energy
mechanismSignals.relation: 选项 indirectly（间接地）概括空后农业用水、发电用水等非直接饮用的用水方式。
空后以 For example 举例，正是对空格这一概括句“间接用水”的具体例证。

mechanismSignals.signalText: use water to make the plants grow
mechanismSignals.relation: 用水种庄稼属于间接用水的典型例子，与选项 indirectly 呼应。

optionFit.fitSummary: 空格是本段的主旨概括句，A 项“我们也间接用水”概括了空后用水种庄稼、发电等例子，且 too 承接上文“直接饮水”，形成直接—间接的递进。

matchedClues.contextSide: farmers ... use water to make the plants grow / produce this energy
matchedClues.relation: 空后所举农业与能源用水正是“间接用水”的实例，与 indirectly 对应。

matchedClues.contextSide: drink lots of water / fill a glass with clean water
matchedClues.relation: 上文讲直接饮水，A 项中的 too 表示“也”，把话题从直接用水拓展到间接用水。

keyDistractors.reason: B 项“身体每个系统都依赖水运转”虽与首段“人体需水”话题相关，但它无法概括空后农业、发电等间接用水的例子，与 For example 的举例方向不符。

q-zj-2020-jan-031.teachingNote: 段首空遇到空后 For example 举例时，要找能被这些例子概括的主旨句。

topicClues: this is not the case for many people
around one in 10 people
drink dirty water
catch diseases
become ill

contextEvidence.beforeQuote: but this is not the case for many people around the world.
contextEvidence.afterQuote: That’s around one in 10 people in the world.

mechanismSignals.relation: 空后 That’s（那相当于）回指空格句给出的数字，That 指代选项中的 750 million people。
选项给出7.5亿这一具体数字，空后用 one in 10 people（十分之一）对其换算说明，前后构成数字—比例的指代衔接。

mechanismSignals.targetText: this is not the case for many people
mechanismSignals.relation: 选项“没有洁净水可喝”正承接空前“对许多人而言并非如此（指有洁净水）”，话题一致。

mechanismSignals.targetText: do not have clean water to drink
mechanismSignals.relation: 空后“喝脏水”与选项“没有洁净水可喝”同属缺水话题场，互为因果。

optionFit.fitSummary: E 项给出“约7.5亿人没有洁净水喝”这一数据，恰好被空后 That’s around one in 10 people 回指换算，并承接空前“许多人并非如此”，引出下文喝脏水致病。

matchedClues.contextSide: That’s around one in 10 people in the world
matchedClues.optionSide: around 750 million people do not have clean water
matchedClues.relation: 空后用 That’s 把7.5亿换算成“十分之一”，构成数字与比例的指代衔接。

matchedClues.contextSide: this is not the case for many people
matchedClues.optionSide: do not have clean water to drink
matchedClues.relation: 空前说许多人并非（随手有洁净水），选项正具体说明这些人没有洁净水可喝。

keyDistractors.reason: D 项也涉及儿童取水，但其落点是“不能上学”，无法被空后 That’s around one in 10 people 这一人口比例回指，数字指代对不上。

q-zj-2020-jan-032.teachingNote: 空后出现 That’s + 数字/比例时，要在选项中找被它回指换算的原始数据。

topicClues: walk many kilometres every day to get water
don’t have time to learn how to read or write
don’t get an education
children

contextEvidence.beforeQuote: in some countries children walk many kilometres every day to get water.
contextEvidence.afterQuote: Therefore, they don’t have time to learn how to read or write and don’t get an education.

mechanismSignals.relation: 空后 Therefore（因此）引出结果，承接空格句的因，构成因果衔接。
选项 If 引出条件“若孩子每天要走数小时取水”，与空后 Therefore 的结果“没时间读写、得不到教育”构成条件—结果链。

mechanismSignals.signalText: walk many kilometres every day to get water
mechanismSignals.targetText: walk many hours a day to get water
mechanismSignals.relation: 空前“每天步行数公里取水”与选项“每天走数小时取水”几乎同义复现。
空后“得不到教育”与选项“不能上学”同属教育话题场，互相印证。

optionFit.fitSummary: D 项“若孩子每天走数小时取水就不能上学”承接空前长途取水之因，又被空后 Therefore 引出的“没时间读写、得不到教育”这一结果强化，构成完整的因果链。

matchedClues.contextSide: children walk many kilometres every day to get water
matchedClues.optionSide: If children walk many hours a day to get water
matchedClues.relation: 空前与选项对“儿童长途取水”这一情境同义复现，话题承接。

matchedClues.contextSide: Therefore, they ... don’t get an education
matchedClues.relation: 空后 Therefore 引出结果，与选项“不能上学”因果对应、语义递进。

keyDistractors.reason: G 项也含“walk a long distance carrying heavy bottles”，看似与长途取水相关，但它强调“体会步行之苦”，与空后 Therefore 引出的“失学/受教育”结果无因果关系。

q-zj-2020-jan-033.teachingNote: 空后用 Therefore 引出结果时，应在选项中找与该结果构成因果链的原因句。

topicClues: On this day every year
countries around the world hold events
educate people about the problems of dirty water
clean water is something that everyone should have

contextEvidence.afterQuote: On this day every year, countries around the world hold events to educate people about the problems of dirty water

mechanismSignals.targetText: March 22nd is the World Day for Water
mechanismSignals.relation: 空后 On this day 中的 this day 回指选项设立的具体日期 March 22nd（世界水日）。
选项给出 March 22nd 这一日期，空后用 this day 指代它，构成日期—指示代词的指代衔接。

mechanismSignals.targetText: hold events to educate people about the problems of dirty water
mechanismSignals.relation: 选项“世界水日”与空后各国举办水问题宣传活动话题一致，奠定本段主题。

optionFit.fitSummary: 本段以介绍“世界水日”为主题，F 项指出1993年联合国把3月22日定为世界水日，恰好被空后 On this day 回指，引出当天各国的宣传活动。

matchedClues.contextSide: On this day every year, countries around the world hold events
matchedClues.optionSide: March 22nd is the World Day for Water
matchedClues.relation: 空后 this day 回指选项设立的日期，承接自然。

matchedClues.contextSide: educate people about the problems of dirty water
matchedClues.relation: 世界水日的宗旨正是宣传水问题，与空后内容主题一致。

keyDistractors.reason: C 项“目的是激励人们了解涉水问题”是对某事目的的解释，句首 It 缺乏先行词，无法被空后 this day 指代，作段首主旨句指代落空。

q-zj-2020-jan-034.teachingNote: 段首空后出现 this day / this 等指示词时，要在选项中找它所回指的具体名词（如某个日期或事件）。

topicClues: walk 6km with six litres of water
People give them money to do this
helps get clean water to as many people as possible
children between the ages of 10 and 15

contextEvidence.beforeQuote: children between the ages of 10 and 15 walk 6km with six litres of water.
contextEvidence.afterQuote: People give them money to do this and all the money helps get clean water

mechanismSignals.targetText: walk 6km with six litres of water
mechanismSignals.relation: 选项 In this way 回指空前学生“负重6升水步行6公里”这一做法，承上启下。

mechanismSignals.targetText: walk a long distance carrying heavy bottles
mechanismSignals.relation: 空后 People give them money to do this 中的 do this 指代选项所述的负重步行行为。

mechanismSignals.signalText: walk 6km with six litres of water
mechanismSignals.targetText: walk a long distance carrying heavy bottles
mechanismSignals.relation: 空前“负重6升水走6公里”与选项“负重水瓶走长路”同义复现，描述同一活动。
选项“背着沉重水瓶”对应空前“六升水”的负重，呼应取水艰辛的话题。

optionFit.fitSummary: G 项以 In this way 回指空前学生负重步行的做法，说明此举让他们体会长途取水之苦，又被空后 do this 进一步指代，前后衔接紧密。

matchedClues.contextSide: walk 6km with six litres of water
matchedClues.optionSide: In this way ... walk a long distance carrying heavy bottles
matchedClues.relation: 选项 In this way 回指空前的负重步行活动，并点明其用意。

matchedClues.contextSide: People give them money to do this
matchedClues.optionSide: they know how it feels to walk a long distance carrying heavy bottles
matchedClues.relation: 空后 do this 指代选项所述行为，三句围绕同一募捐活动衔接。

keyDistractors.reason: D 项虽含 walk ... to get water，话题相近，但其句意是“孩子取水就不能上学”，与空前英国学生体验式负重步行募捐的情境不符，也无法被空后 do this 指代。

q-zj-2020-jan-035.teachingNote: 空格夹在两句之间且前后出现 this way / do this 等回指词时，选 In this way 之类承上启下、回指前一做法的句子。
